style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots, cool light grey #EEF2F7 for information panels, deep clinical blue #1D4E9E for claim and icon fields, one consistent rounded-corner card language
style.direction: clinical research-grade supplement commerce, clean pharma-minimal
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons inside outlined circles, stroke in #FFFFFF or #1D4E9E, flat, no gradients, no third-party seal artwork
style.lightingSystem: cool high-key studio light, front-left softbox key with a fill card, skimming side light only for texture macro, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars, 5600K
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clinical research-grade supplement visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, deep clinical blue #1D4E9E, cool light grey #EEF2F7 and neutral board grey #E4E8EE with off-white capsule tone #F4F1EC; cool 5600K high-key studio lighting with a front-left softbox key, fill card and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with information carried only by blank label bars; thin single-weight line icons inside outlined circles, no seal artwork; stable upright product scale with intentionally blank label faces; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no certification badges, no numeric values.
noDrift: no numeric dosage, strength or size values
style.presentationRules: stable upright bottle scale across the set, caps always closed, capsules shown as plain opaque off-white #F4F1EC cylinders, label faces left intentionally blank
style.surfaceSystem: matte neutral board #E4E8EE and seamless white sweep #FFFFFF, no wood grain, no marble veining
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, information carried by blank label bars and empty callout lines only, no rendered copy
